allowedAuditFindings.statement: The baseline GitHub API observation reports main as unprotected; repository code cannot enforce review or required checks.
Persistence is now a transactional process-local SQLite/WAL snapshot plus audit ledger, but cross-process/multi-instance state coordination, HA and restore evidence remain unproven.
No correlated traces, metrics and logs or SLO model is present.
CI actions are pinned to immutable commits, but signed build provenance is not produced and verified by the repository gate.
Backup, restore, RTO and RPO are declared blockers rather than implemented controls.

boundary: Debt is bound to semantic finding fingerprints, not IDs. The set may shrink but must not expand or be semantically reused after the anchored one-shot v1->v2 migration. Stale allowances are fatal.
